snippet.title: ZERO PARADES: For Dead Spies - The Friends You Left to Die
snippet.description:
Introducing the "Whole Sick Crew," a key band of characters in #ZEROPARADES: For Dead Spies.

Five years ago, you led your team into the abyss and have been haunted by your failures ever since. Now, back in the city-state of Portofiro, you must rebuild your broken network...

Read more on the @PlayStation Blog: 

https://blog.playstation.com/2026/04/23/zero-parades-for-dead-spies-meet-the-whole-sick-cast-of-characters/

ZERO PARADES: For Dead Spies arrives on PC May 21st, coming to PlayStation®5 (PS5®) later this year.
